newsitem.title: ESTONIA: UHIS LAUNCHES RUSSIAN SECURITIES FIRM.
newsitem.headline: UHIS LAUNCHES RUSSIAN SECURITIES FIRM.

text.p: Major bank Uhispank and an investment company Arengufinantseering (Development Finance) have set up a joint venture to launch a securities trading firm in Russia, Aripaev newspaper said on Tuesday.
The capital of the company, Uhisarengu (Uhis Development), is 100,000 kroons and the stake of both partners is equal.
Uhispank capital market division head Margus Kangro was quoted by the newspaper as saying that the company's first priority is to acquire sufficient knowledge of the local market.
The company also plans to open a representative office in Moscow this autumn.
